channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Indian Rupee: Gradual strengthening path outlined – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Michael Wan expects USD/INR to grind lower over the next 3–6 months towards 94.00, before rebounding to 96.00 in the next calendar year.

item.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD hesitates at $62.00 after a two-day rally
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) consolidates gains in the $61.70 area after being rejected ahead of $63.00. The pair is trimming gains on Thursday, after following a nearly 7% rally over the last two days, but downside attempts remain limited so far, as lower Oil prices and a weak US Dollar keep providing support.

item.title: Equities: Tech-led rally faces growing caution – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team highlights that global equities have gained about 5% over five sessions, with cyclicals and growth outperforming defensives and value, pointing to a tech-driven move.

item.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Holds gains above 99.50, while bearish bias persists
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 99.75 in the early European trading hours on Thursday.

item.title: Indian Rupee edges lower as oil prices rebound
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday. The USD/INR pair rises to near 95.22 after rebounding from the fresh monthly low of 94.83 posted the previous day.

item.title: Oil: Distillate exports tighten market – ING
item.description: ING strategists Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note Oil prices remain under pressure, with ICE Brent trading below $80/bbl as markets focus on a potential US-Iran deal to reopen flows through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Likely return to two-month low near 155.00
item.description: The USD/JPY pair holds onto a three-day recovery move near 157.80 during the European trading session on Thursday.

item.title: Euro: Upside bias needs close above resistance against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight that EUR/USD extended modest gains to close at 1.1551, with mild upward momentum still intact. Intraday, the pair may test 1.1565, though a move to 1.1600 is seen as unlikely without stronger momentum.

item.title: Canadian Dollar flatlines as traders watch possible US-Iran deal
item.description: The USD/CAD pair USD/CAD holds steady around 1.4015 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. Traders await a possible US-Iran deal, which could give direction to the pair. The US Initial Jobless Claims report is due later on Thursday.

item.title: Euro steadies at three-week highs amid positive data and lower Oil prices
item.description: The Euro (EUR) remains practically flat against the US Dollar (USD) at the European session opening times on Thursday, with the EUR/USD pair holding gains at the 1.1550 area after rallying about 1.6% from last week's lows.

item.title: 3.1%: Germany Factory Orders climb in June, beating estimates
item.description: Germany's Factory Orders rose in June, suggesting that the country’s manufacturing sector activity gained momentum, according to the official data published by the Federal Statistics Office on Thursday.

item.title: Gold sticks to modest gains below $4,300 and seven-week top amid modest USD uptick
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to find acceptance above the $4,300 mark and retreats from its highest level since June 18, touched during the Asian session on Thursday amid the emergence of some US Dollar (USD) buying.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Downside likely towards $67 on Hormuz reopening hopes
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), futures on NYMEX, trades 0.45% lower to near $74 during the early European trading session on Thursday, closer to its three-week low of $73.51 posted the previous day.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Eyes upside despite pullback from June high, around 0.7065
item.description: The AUD/USD pair edges lower during the Asian session on Thursday and moves away from the highest level since June 17, touched the previous day. Spot prices currently trade just below 0.7050, though the downside potential seems limited.

item.title: British Pound loses ground to near 1.3450 as traders await possible US-Iran deal
item.description: The GBP/USD pair drifts lower to near 1.3460 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. Conflicting rhetoric from the US and Iranian officials about a potential deal fuels market concerns, dragging the British Pound (GBP) lower against the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah in focus as BI leadership race begins
item.description: USD/IDR inches higher after registering nearly 0.5% losses in the previous day, trading around 17,960 during the Asian hours on Thursday. Traders are keeping a close eye on the nomination process following the sudden resignation of Bank Indonesia (BI) Governor Perry Warjiyo late last month.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Falls to near 182.00 amid prevailing bearish bias
item.description: EUR/JPY depreciates after two days of gains, trading around 182.10 during the Asian hours on Thursday. The currency cross is maintaining a bearish near-term bias as it holds beneath both the nine-day and 50-day Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs).

item.title: British Pound consolidates vs Yen; bullish bias remains amid Japan's fiscal concerns
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross struggles to capitalize on this week's solid rebound from the vicinity of mid-209.00s, or a four-month low, and edges lower during the Asian session on Thursday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Thursday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Softens to near 111.00 as bearish bias holds below key technical barriers
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades in negative territory around 111.15 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. A coordinated currency intervention by the United States (US) and Japan provides some support to the Japanese Yen (JPY) against the Australian Dollar (AUD).

item.title: Swiss Franc receives support as US Dollar weakens on easing risk aversion
item.description: USD/CHF extends its losses for the third consecutive day, trading around 0.8060 during the Asian hours on Thursday. The pair depreciates as the US Dollar (USD) faces headwinds from declining safe-haven demand.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Looks set to extend advance beyond 1.1600
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades broadly firm at around 1.1555 against the US Dollar (USD) during the Asian trading session on Thursday. The major currency pair reflects strength as the US Dollar is broadly under pressure due to deteriorating United States (US) employment conditions.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises above $62.00 on easing inflation concerns
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) remains stronger for the fourth consecutive day, trading around $62.20 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Thursday.

item.title: United States Dollar Index (DXY) struggles near 99.65 and remains close to multi-week low
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, trades with a negative bias for the third straight day and hovers around the 99.65 region during the Asian session on Thursday.

item.title: Japanese Yen gathers strength to near 157.50 on US-backed intervention
item.description: The USD/JPY pair trades in negative territory near 157.65 during the early Asian trading hours on Thursday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) strengthens against the US Dollar (USD) following a coordinated currency intervention by the United States (US) and Japan.

item.title: Canadian Dollar remains on the front foot vs USD as oil rebounds and Fed hike bets fade
item.description: The USD/CAD pair remains on the back foot during the Asian session on Thursday, with bears now awaiting a break below the 1.4000 psychological mark before positioning for an extension of the previous day's pullback from a one-week top.

item.title: US President Donald Trump's administration refunds $100bn of ‘liberation day’ tariffs
item.description: US President Donald Trump's administration has paid back $100bn in "Liberation Day" tariff refunds to businesses through customs officials, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar remains calm following Trade Balance data
item.description: AUD/USD steadies after two days of gains, trading around 0.7060 during the Asian hours on Thursday. The pair moves little as the Australian Dollar (AUD) remains silent following the release of domestic Trade Balance data.

item.title: Australia’s Trade Balance shows a surprise surplus of 1,929M MoM in June, vs. -1,100 expected
item.description: Australia's Trade Balance shifted to surplus of A$1,929M MoM in June, followed a deficit of 2,367M in the previous reading (revised from A$3,018M), according to the latest foreign trade data published by the Australian Bureau of Statistics on Thursday.

item.title: British Pound holds steady above 1.3450 as Iran hopes and Fed repricing weigh on USD
item.description: The GBP/USD pair is seen consolidating its gains recorded over the past two days and trading around the 1.3470 region during the Asian session on Thursday.
